purpose: Improve delivery of the same approved Nhật Phong voice before generating the new documentary take.

observations: The guide applies its voice selection, audio-tag and punctuation advice to Eleven v3.
Eleven v3 does not support SSML break tags. Standard punctuation, text structure and audio tags can influence pacing.
Ellipses can add pauses; capitals can increase emphasis. Tags should suit the chosen voice and require representative testing.
The source recommends writing numbers as words to reduce multilingual reading ambiguity and using correct formatting.

Voice/model and source-language fit matter. Higher stability can sound monotonous, while lower stability can yield unstable delivery. A value around 50 is presented as a common starting point, not a quality guarantee.

The page says v3 speed and similarity are unavailable in their individual sections, but a later speed FAQ makes a broader claim. Treat this as a documentation inconsistency, not evidence that a particular API/backend setting changed performance.
The settings reference describes stability variation, normal speed at 1.0, incremental changes, and representative tests.
It says style and speed work with v2/v3, which differs from the playground page's v3-specific speed statement.

appliedEditorialChoices: Keep voice 6adFm46eyy74snVn6YrT, eleven_v3, language vi and the pinned project settings stability 0.5, similarity_boost 0.8, speed 1.0.
Use plain Vietnamese with numbers written out, complete short contrast sentences, real questions and paragraph breaks. Avoid SSML or untested emotional tags in every line.
Freeze the exact spoken text before request/alignment. Do not speed up the resulting voice or video to change delivery.
Punctuation guidance is a production choice, not a claim that this particular output is expressive. Actual speech still needs listening feedback.
verificationLimits: No paid generation was made by this reviewer.
No Vietnamese-specific prosody guarantee or current primary-source mapping of 0.5 to a named Natural mode was established in the pages inspected.
No listening/input audio analysis tool was exposed in this reviewer's callable tool inventory. Playback in a UI or Markdown does not establish agent listening.
Local faster-whisper base and small caches and the faster_whisper package are present. ASR can diagnose word/number/tail coverage, but cannot establish natural expression, emphasis or voice quality.
